_comment: Source catalogue (i18n-l10n.md §3). ICU MessageFormat, keys hierarchical and semantic. English is the source language; every other locale is translated from this file. The backend never emits these sentences - it emits the key plus params, and the client renders them.
errors.malformed_request: The request could not be read.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.conflict: This action conflicts with the current state.
errors.version_conflict: Someone else changed this entry in the meantime.
errors.gone: This entry has been permanently deleted.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again in a moment.
errors.method_not_allowed: This address does not support that operation.
errors.payload_too_large: The request is larger than this installation accepts.
errors.dependency_unavailable: A required service is temporarily unavailable.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Reference: {request_id}
errors.capability_not_supported: That kind of entry does not support this field.
config.db_dsn_missing: {variable} is not set. Hubtask needs a PostgreSQL connection.
config.secret_key_missing: {variable} is not set. Without it, stored credentials cannot be encrypted.
config.secret_key_too_short: {variable} must be at least {minimum} characters long.
config.secret_file_unreadable: {variable} points to a file that cannot be read.
config.tenancy_invalid: {variable} must be either single or multi.
config.roles_empty: {variable} names no role. At least one of api, worker, scheduler, automation is required.
config.log_format_invalid: {variable} must be either json or text.
config.log_level_invalid: {variable} must be one of debug, info, warn, error.
config.db_pool_invalid: {variable} is outside the valid range. The minimum pool size cannot exceed the maximum.
config.duration_invalid: {variable} must be a duration such as 30s, 5m or 1h30m.
config.rate_limit_invalid: {variable} must be at least 1. Zero would block every request.
config.storage_kind_invalid: {variable} must be either local or s3.
config.storage_path_missing: {variable} is not set, although local storage is configured.
config.s3_incomplete: {variable} is missing. Object storage needs a bucket and credentials.
config.smtp_port_invalid: {variable} must be a port between 1 and 65535.
config.smtp_from_missing: {variable} is not set, although an SMTP server is configured.
config.smtp_security_invalid: {variable} must be one of starttls, tls, none.
config.tracing_endpoint_missing: {variable} is not set, although tracing is enabled. Spans would be built and discarded.
config.locale_invalid: {variable} must be a BCP 47 language tag such as en, de-AT or pt-BR.
config.redirects_invalid: {variable} must be between 0 and {maximum}. A longer chain is not a site that moved.
config.allowed_host_invalid: {variable} takes host names, not URLs. {value} contains a scheme or a path.
config.timezone_unknown: {variable} must be an IANA time zone such as Europe/Berlin. {value} is not one.
config.cors_origin_invalid: {variable} takes complete origins such as https://app.example.com. {value} is not one.
config.backup_not_configured: No backup target is configured. A restore drill is a release criterion.
config.smtp_missing: No SMTP server is configured. Notifications by email are unavailable.
config.base_url_missing: HUBTASK_BASE_URL is not set. Links in emails and feeds will be wrong.
config.oidc_missing_in_multi_tenancy: Multi-tenant operation without an OIDC issuer. Only personal access tokens will work.
config.egress_allowlist_missing: No egress allowlist is configured. In multi-tenant operation, outbound calls should be restricted to known hosts.
config.egress_private_networks_allowed: Outbound calls to private networks are allowed. A webhook target can reach services inside your network.
config.smtp_without_tls: SMTP to {host} is configured without TLS. Credentials travel unencrypted.
request.body_malformed: The request body is not valid JSON.
request.body_missing: This operation needs a request body.
request.body_too_large: The request body may be at most {limit_bytes} bytes.
access.credential_required: This operation needs you to be signed in.
access.insufficient_scope: The token used is not allowed to do this. It would need the scope {scope}.
access.scheme_unsupported: This API expects a bearer token in the Authorization header.
access.tenant_mismatch: The token belongs to a different workspace than the one requested.
access.rate_limit_exceeded: Too many requests for this {level}. Please slow down.
access.token_malformed: That is not a valid access token.
access.token_unknown: That access token is not known here.
access.token_expired: That access token has expired. Create a new one.
access.token_revoked: That access token has been revoked.
access.token_tenant_missing: An access token has to belong to a workspace.
access.token_secret_short: An access token needs its full length. Create a new one.
access.not_permitted: Your role in this workspace does not allow that ({permission}).
access.account_not_active: This account cannot be used at the moment. Its status is {status}.
idempotency.key_malformed: The Idempotency-Key header has to be a UUID.
idempotency.key_reused: This Idempotency-Key was already used for a different request. Use a new one.
idempotency.in_progress: An identical request is still running. Try again in a moment.
idempotency.body_unreadable: The request body could not be read to the end.
containers.type_unknown: {value} is not a kind of container. Use HUB or COLLECTION.
containers.name_empty: A hub or collection needs a name.
containers.name_too_long: The name may be at most {maximum} characters long.
containers.name_malformed: The name has to fit on one line.
containers.hub_has_no_parent: A hub is the top level and sits in nothing.
containers.collection_needs_parent: A collection has to sit in a hub.
containers.not_found: That hub or collection does not exist.
containers.name_taken: A hub or collection called {name} already exists here.
containers.parent_archived: That hub is archived. Unarchive it before adding anything to it.
containers.parent_trashed: That hub is in the trash.
containers.identity_incomplete: This installation is misconfigured and could not create that entry.
containers.completion_policy_unknown: {value} is not a completion policy this installation knows.
items.type_unknown: {value} is not a kind of entry. Use TASK, WORK_PACKAGE or ACTIVITY.
items.title_too_long: The title may be at most {maximum} characters long.
items.title_malformed: The title has to fit on one line. Longer text belongs in the notes.
items.profile_mismatched: This installation is misconfigured and could not create that entry.
items.identity_incomplete: This installation is misconfigured and could not create that entry.
items.path_malformed: This installation is misconfigured and could not create that entry.
items.depth_inconsistent: This installation is misconfigured and could not create that entry.
items.parent_item_required: A {item_type} has to sit inside another entry.
items.type_unsupported: This workspace does not offer {item_type} entries.
items.depth_exceeded: A {item_type} cannot sit that deep. At most {maximum} levels are allowed here.
items.parent_archived: The entry above is archived. Unarchive it before adding anything to it.
items.parent_trashed: The entry above is in the trash.
items.collection_required: Entries live in a collection, not in a {container_type}.
items.collection_archived: That collection is archived. Unarchive it before adding anything to it.
items.collection_trashed: That collection is in the trash.
items.collection_or_parent_required: Say which collection the entry belongs to, or which entry it sits in.
items.trashed: That entry is in the trash. Restore it before changing it.
items.archived: That entry is archived. Unarchive it before changing it.
items.version_conflict: Someone else changed that entry in the meantime. Read it again and reapply.
items.cascade_not_supported: This installation cannot complete a whole subtree in one step yet.
items.collection_missing: This entry refers to a collection that is no longer there.
items.parent_not_in_collection: That entry is in another collection.
items.profiles_incoherent: This installation is misconfigured and could not create that entry.
accounts.email_empty: An invitation needs an email address.
accounts.email_malformed: {value} does not look like an email address.
accounts.email_too_long: An email address may be at most {maximum} characters long.
accounts.email_taken: Somebody with that address is already in this workspace.
accounts.display_name_empty: This person needs a name to show beside their actions.
accounts.display_name_too_long: The name may be at most {maximum} characters long.
accounts.display_name_malformed: The name has to fit on one line.
accounts.identity_incomplete: This installation is misconfigured and could not create that account.
accounts.locale_invalid: {value} is not a language tag. Use a form such as de, de-AT or pt-BR.
accounts.time_zone_invalid: {value} is not a time zone. Use an IANA name such as Europe/Berlin.
accounts.week_start_invalid: A week can start on MONDAY, SUNDAY or SATURDAY.
accounts.not_found: That person is not in this workspace.
groups.name_too_long: The name may be at most {maximum} characters long.
groups.name_malformed: The name has to fit on one line.
groups.name_taken: A group called {name} already exists here.
groups.description_too_long: The description may be at most {maximum} characters long.
groups.identity_incomplete: This installation is misconfigured and could not create that group.
groups.version_conflict: Someone else changed this group in the meantime.
memberships.subject_ambiguous: A role is given to a person or to a group, not to both and not to neither.
memberships.role_unknown: {value} is not a role. Use OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER, CONTRIBUTOR, VIEWER or GUEST.
memberships.scope_invalid: {value} is not a level a role can be given at.
memberships.identity_incomplete: This installation is misconfigured and could not record that role.
events.payload_unserialisable: This installation could not announce that change.
events.payload_unreadable: This installation could not read a recorded change and has not delivered it yet.
events.consumer_unnamed: This installation is misconfigured: a subscriber without a name cannot be told what it has already seen.
events.envelope_incomplete: This installation could not announce that change.
events.type_unknown: This installation could not announce that change.
events.causation_too_deep: This change was triggered by a chain of automations that goes too deep. Hubtask stopped it after {maximum} steps.
events.completion_inconsistent: This installation could not announce that change.
usecase.field_unknown: This field does not exist on this operation.
usecase.field_type_invalid: This field has the wrong type.
usecase.unknown: This installation knows no operation called {use_case}.
usecase.registration_incomplete: This installation is misconfigured: the operation {use_case} is registered without {missing}.
usecase.duplicate_registration: This installation is misconfigured: the operation {use_case} is registered twice.
automation.run_as_missing: This rule has no account to run as. Set one before enabling it.
automation.action_unknown: This installation has no automation action called {action}.
audit.tenant_mismatch: This installation could not record that action and therefore did not carry it out.
audit.entry_incomplete: This installation could not record that action and therefore did not carry it out.
audit.entry_unserialisable: This installation could not record that action and therefore did not carry it out.
audit.actor_kind_invalid: This installation could not record that action and therefore did not carry it out.
sync.payload_unserialisable: This installation could not record that change for offline devices.
sync.change_without_clock: This installation could not record that change for offline devices.
sync.hlc_malformed: {value} is not a valid change timestamp.
sync.hlc_incomplete: This installation could not stamp that change.
sync.hlc_device_malformed: This installation could not stamp that change.
sync.hlc_counter_exhausted: This installation could not stamp that change.
ordering.bounds_invalid: This installation could not work out where to put that entry.
ordering.key_malformed: This installation could not work out where to put that entry.
ordering.space_exhausted: There is no room left above the first entry in this list. Sort it once, then try again.
rest.use_case_not_wired: This installation is misconfigured and cannot answer that request.
route.unknown: There is nothing at this address.
route.operation_not_available: This installation does not offer that operation yet.
dependency.unavailable: A service this feature needs cannot be reached at the moment. Everything else keeps working.
dependency.timeout: {dependency} did not answer in time. Please try again in a moment.
dependency.circuit_open: {dependency} is unreachable at the moment. Hubtask has stopped calling it and will try again shortly.
dependency.saturated: {dependency} is busy. Please try again in a moment.
dependency.target_scheme: Hubtask only calls http and https addresses. {target} is neither.
dependency.target_credentials: The address for {target} must not contain a user name or a password. Use a header instead.
dependency.target_not_allowed: {host} is not on the list of addresses this installation may call.
dependency.target_blocked: {target} points into a private or reserved network. Hubtask does not call addresses inside its own infrastructure.
dependency.target_unresolvable: The address {host} could not be resolved at the moment.
dependency.too_many_redirects: The address redirected more than {limit} times. Hubtask stopped following it.
dependency.response_too_large: The answer was larger than the permitted {limit_bytes} bytes.
capacity.shed: Hubtask is under heavy load and has postponed this operation. Please try again in {retry_after_seconds} seconds.
